title: hive bot stop output (v1)
description: Stable contract emitted by `hive bot stop --json`. Idempotent: a stop against a non-running bot returns ok=true with running=false.

running.description: True only if the bot is still running after the stop attempt.

was_running.description: True if a live bot was signalled by this call.

pid_file.description: Absolute path of the bot PID file.
